t: 10-year life CO alarm designed to accurately measure low levels of carbon monoxide within the home, with a loud and clear alarm. Can be wall-mounted or used as a portable unit and positioned as required. Low-battery warning sound which can be suppressed for 8 hours using the test button. Supplied with 2 x AA batteries, which can be replaced when needed. Suitable for private and rented homes in England, Ireland and Wales. Not suitable for residential properties in Scotland. Please refer to guidance.
